AboutVisionMissionSections.title: Ambedkar Study Circle
AboutDescription: The College launched ASC as part of its endeavour to improve teaching and learning outcomes by providing students with a distinctive platform and chance for a well-rounded educational experience. The significant activities planned and actions conducted by this centre have undoubtedly exposed the pupils’ brains to fresh perspectives. Cross-cutting issues relating to social abnormalities, professional obstacles, etc. have been taken up by ASC.

sections.title: Vision
sections.description: “The key aim of the Ambedkar Study Circle is to act as a hub for learning about and conducting research on Ambedkar’s writings, as well as to develop a dialogue about the social, cultural, and political concerns that affect the lives of oppressed populations.”
